2607.23794.title: PathScale-R1: Cross-scale Reasoning for Pathological Image Analysis
2607.23794.paper_summary: Pathological diagnosis is inherently multi-scale, requiring the integration of global tissue architecture at low magnification with cellular morphology at higher magnification. However, existing pathology benchmarks and vision-language models (VLMs) are still largely developed under single-scale settings, limiting their ability to learn clinically meaningful multi-magnification reasoning. Moreover, naively constructed visual question answering (VQA) tasks may be susceptible to text-only or superficial visual shortcuts, leading to unreliable assessments of visual understanding. To address these limitations, we introduce a benchmark and training framework for shortcut-resistant cross-scale pathology reasoning. We design an Adversarial Text-only Screening strategy for semantic reasoning questions and a Structure-controlled Distractor Sampling strategy for visual grounding questions, encouraging models to rely on cross-scale visual evidence. Based on this pipeline, we construct PathScale-VQA, a high-quality cross-scale pathology VQA benchmark with 10,373 multiple-choice questions grounded in 1,368 diagnostic paths across multiple magnification levels. Building on the semantic reasoning set, PathScale-R1 is optimized through Difficulty-driven Reasoning Distillation supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning with a Scale-aware Reasoning Structure reward, which encourages the use of evidence across magnifications. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance of PathScale-R1 on cross-scale reasoning tasks and effective transfer to conventional single-scale pathology VQA. Our code is available at https://github.com/iMVR-PL/PathScale-R1.
2607.23794.paper_summary_zh: 病理診斷本質上是多尺度的，需要將低倍放大下的全局組織結構與高倍放大下的細胞形態進行整合。<lb/>然而，現有的病理基準和視覺-語言模型（VLMs）仍然主要是在單尺度設置下開發的，這限制了它們學習臨床意義的多倍放大推理的能力。<lb/>此外，天真構建的視覺問題回答（VQA）任務可能容易受到僅依賴文本或表面視覺捷徑的影響，導致對視覺理解的不可靠評估。<lb/>為了解決這些限制，我們引入了一個基準和訓練框架，以抵抗捷徑的跨尺度病理推理。<lb/>我們為語義推理問題設計了一種對抗性文本篩選策略，並為視覺定位問題設計了一種結構控制的干擾樣本策略，鼓勵模型依賴跨尺度的視覺證據。<lb/>基於這一流程，我們構建了PathScale-VQA，一個高質量的跨尺度病理VQA基準，包含10,373個多選題，這些題目基於1,368條診斷路徑，涵蓋多個放大級別。<lb/>在語義推理集的基礎上，PathScale-R1通過基於難度的推理蒸餾監督微調，然後進行強化學習，並使用一種基於尺度的推理結構獎勵，來優化，這鼓勵在不同放大倍數之間使用證據。<lb/>大量實驗表明，PathScale-R1在跨尺度推理任務上達到了最先進的性能，並有效轉移到傳統的單尺度病理VQA。<lb/>我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/iMVR-PL/PathScale-R1 獲得。
